method: state = quintile of trailing-365-day percentile known at the prior close (lag 1); excess = mean forward return in state minus mean over all days of the period; n_ind = independent episodes (flagged days more than h days apart); mdd30 = worst close-to-close drawdown within 30 days; agreement = sign of 30-day excess across train/validation/test when each has >= 3 episodes. Description of the past, not a forecast.

lsr.caveat: The dashboard long/short series stepped up in level in 2021, so its 2021 'top fifth' days are partly an artefact; since mid-2024 a top reading mostly means the price already fell over the past month. notes.title: What was tested
notes.text: Three pre-registered passes (PREREG, PREREG2, PREREG3): single and conditioned extremes of funding, open interest, basis, long/short ratio, DVOL, skew and risk reversals by tenor, butterfly, ATM term structure, IV/RV, put/call, at 1-90 days, on returns and on forward drawdowns; time in a crowded state and the exit from it; TD Sequential setups and countdowns on 1H, 4H, 1D and 3D; alt cross-section reversal and momentum. About 1,300 cells. Entry one bar after the signal, three periods, Newey-West errors, independent-episode counts, costs and carry.

notes.title: What passed
notes.text: Nothing that survived refutation. One drawdown cell passed the rule (ETH daily TD9 buy, 10 days) and is consistent with chance: 4 validation episodes, a random-date placebo passes as often, BTC does not confirm, the sign flips at 20 and 30 days.

notes.title: Overheating readings
notes.text: At 10-30 days, crowded funding, basis and open interest were followed by shallower drawdowns, not deeper, in 2021-25. At 30-90 days, USD open interest at its highs was followed by weak returns, but that is price at its highs (the control row) plus the 2022 bear. Time already spent in a crowded state did not add information once price duration was controlled; the 2024-25 pattern of long high-OI runs ending in crashes is three episodes (Aug 2024, Feb 2025, Oct 2025).

notes.title: TD Sequential
notes.text: TD9 and TD13 completions on daily closes are about as frequent as on a random walk (roughly one per 70 bars). No completion carried the textbook bounce or fade across periods on any timeframe; the daily buy-countdown-13 was followed by further weakness in 18 of 24 episodes in 2019-25, which is too few, too count-specific and already contradicted in 2026 to use. The counts are shown as structure.

notes.title: How to read this tab
notes.text: A row says what happened after past days in the same fifth, with the number of independent episodes. An 'across periods' badge of consistent means the 30-day direction agreed in 2019-24H1, 2024H2-25 and 2026; it does not mean the reading caused it, and the caveats say where a simpler explanation exists. Rows with fewer than 10 episodes describe a few events.
